facts.fact: Digital Economy minister Mark-Alexandre Doumba outlined Gabon's 2025-2030 digital development plan, built on four priorities: infrastructure, public services, cybersecurity and innovation, per ITWeb Africa; no adoption by cabinet or head of state is stated.
The minister described the digital development plan as running 2025 to 2030, per ITWeb Africa.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy, Digitalisation and Innovation
